description: Unit: shared cadence generation covers supported frequencies, advance/arrears assignment, horizon guards, and assumption override precedence.
Unit: fixed compute covers plan pricing, FMV allocation, proration, advance termination, duplicate guard, tax, and explanations.
Unit: hourly compute covers duration, minimums, rounding, rate precedence, overtime, missing pricing, tax, and explanations.
Unit: usage compute covers minimums, flat and tiered boundaries, rate precedence, tax, and explanations.
Unit: bucket compute covers base fee, included consumption, rollover, overage, expiry, and multi-period state.
Unit: product and license compute covers quantity, currency price, overrides, proration, tax, and item classification.
Unit: discount and adjustment computation covers percentage/fixed windows and application ordering.
Golden: representative production contracts remain byte-equivalent through each compute-family extraction.
DB integration: snapshot captures client schedule anchors, assignment dates/location, catalog identity, configs, tiers, schedules, and tenant scope.
DB integration: fixed/hourly/usage/bucket/product/license mixed-cadence scenario produces expected invoice windows, lines, totals, tax, and explanations.
DB integration: simulation against a migrated schema leaves billing, contract, tax, numbering, and event-related rows unchanged.
DB integration: invalid or cross-tenant identifiers are rejected without leaking data.
Unit: comparison aligns origin and synthetic lines and reports added, removed, changed, per-period, and horizon deltas.
DB integration: recent averages and replay aggregate actual time/usage into editable period assumptions.
DB integration: replayed simulation compares correctly with a seeded issued invoice.
Component: scenario editor supports the complete edit surface, modified indicators, reset-line, and reset-all without server writes.
Component: assumptions, timeline, invoice preview, diagnostics, explanations, and compare mode render and interact correctly.
Playwright EE: contract-detail scenario edit, simulate, expand, explain, and compare journey succeeds.
Playwright EE: recent-average and historical replay journey succeeds.
Playwright EE: wizard draft and template simulation journeys succeed.
Playwright CE: Simulator entry points render the Enterprise upgrade state and do not load EE implementation.
Regression: full billing unit and DB integration suites pass after all extractions.
Build: billing, server, EE server, and CE/EE product compositions typecheck and build successfully.
